description: Create a channel on an agent or an app. On an agent: a cron or heartbeat channel that wakes it on a schedule, a webhook channel that lets callers outside Valet reach it, or an mcp channel that serves it as an MCP server; what the agent does when it fires is the prompt file channels/<name>.md in its source. On an app: a webhook, cron, or heartbeat channel whose deliveries Valet posts to path in the app, so a private app takes webhooks and scheduled work without becoming public. Valet checks a webhook's signature before anything reaches the app, then posts the request as the sender sent it; a cron or heartbeat fire posts a small JSON body. Each delivery carries an X-Valet-Visitor token of kind channel and a delivery_key to treat as an idempotency key; return 2xx, and anything else retries for about a day. A webhook is signed by a secret held as an environment variable of the agent or app, and this never takes or returns a secret value: name it first in set_env_vars secret_names, whose request page the person opens to enter it, then pass its name as secret_name. A webhook without secret_name is refused. Creating a channel that already exists with the same kind and settings reports it and changes nothing; different settings are refused, so destroy it first. Slack and Telegram need a browser, so for them this gives the step to take and creates nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account.

channel.description: The new channel's name, such as stripe-events. On an agent it names the prompt file channels/<name>.md that says what to do when the channel fires.

channel_kind.description: The kind of channel: cron, heartbeat, webhook, mcp, slack, or telegram, as list_catalog_channels lists them. An app takes webhook, cron, or heartbeat only. Slack and Telegram give the step to take instead of creating anything.

name.description: The agent's or app's name, as list_services shows it: the one that will hold the channel.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the agent or app belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

path.description: Needed for a channel on an app, and only there: the path in the app that handles each delivery, such as /webhooks/stripe.

schedule.description: For cron, a schedule such as 'weekdays at 9:00am' or 'every 30 minutes' or a five-field cron expression. For heartbeat, an interval such as '15m', from 30s to 24h. Not used by other kinds.

secret_name.description: Needed for webhook. The name of an environment variable on this agent or app that holds the signing secret, named first in set_env_vars secret_names so the person enters it. Not used by other kinds.

timezone.description: For cron, an IANA timezone such as America/New_York. Omit for UTC.

verify_scheme.description: For webhook, how the sender signs: hmac-sha256 (the default), static-token for a sender that cannot sign, stripe, svix, slack, or mercury. This tool creates signed webhooks only, so there is no way to turn verification off.

name: create_channel

agent.description: Name of the agent or app that owns the channel.

already.description: True when the channel already existed with the same kind and settings, so nothing changed. Absent when this call created it.

channel.description: The channel's name, which list_channels and destroy_channel take.

channel_kind.description: The channel's kind: cron, heartbeat, webhook, or mcp.

holder_kind.description: app when the channel is on an app. Absent for a channel on an agent.

next_fire_at.description: When the channel next fires, as an RFC 3339 time in UTC. Absent when no fire is scheduled and on a repeat call.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

path.description: The path in the app that handles each delivery. Absent for a channel on an agent.

prompt_path.description: The prompt file in the agent's source that tells it what to do when the channel fires. Absent for a channel on an app and on a repeat call.

schedule.description: When the channel fires: the cron schedule, or every followed by the interval for a heartbeat. Absent for other kinds.

secret_name.description: Name of the environment variable that holds a webhook's signing secret. Never the secret itself. Absent for other kinds and on a repeat call.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of a cron schedule. Absent for other kinds and on a repeat call.

url.description: The address callers post to, for a webhook or mcp channel on an agent. Absent for other channels.

warning.description: A note about the new channel the caller should heed. Absent when there is none.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

step.description: What the person does in a browser to finish creating the channel, such as installing a Slack app. Returned instead of a create result; no channel exists until they do it.

url.description: Address of the page where the person finishes the step. Absent when the page has no address to give.

title: Create a channel
